content.text:
Implemented all 12 work items and checked the package against all 10 sections of `SPEC.md`.

Flag rates now count only `True` as flagged and weight each transcript equally. Log parsing handles `1`, `0`, and empty flags, skips blank lines and comments, and reports original line numbers for malformed records. Deduplication keeps the last record for each ID, and summaries use calendar-day windows, round the pooled rate to three decimal places, and count only nonempty groups.

The audit also fixed group ranking, per-group rates, and streak counting. I updated the README and added regression tests for `None` flags, duplicate IDs, and other spec edge cases.

Verification: `python -m pytest` — 22 passed.
